measured_cause: The deterministic sampler advances before GradScaler reports whether an optimizer update succeeded. Eleven overflow-skipped attempts therefore consumed records without allowing them to influence weights. At this seed and budget, one compatible record occurred only in skipped attempts. A no-skip simulation of the exact 23,968 successful batches covers all 39,946 records.
bounded_repair: Snapshot both teacher and preservation samplers before every tentative batch. If GradScaler skips the optimizer update, restore both snapshots and retry the identical batch at the reduced scale. Advance sampled-record, recovery, token, and unique-coverage accounting only after a successful update.
decision: Do not export or screen v15 as the full-budget candidate. Rerun budget index 3 independently from the unchanged v6 parent with the same seed, successful-step count, data, losses, learning rates, recovery schedule, decoder, and GPU device under the transactional sampler.
claim_boundary: This is a procedural coverage failure, not a quality result or resource limit. The checkpoint is retained for audit but is ineligible for promotion.
